entries.subject: DAMIT 16298: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 16298, version 2023-10-03, pole (223°, -89°), period 67.5041 h, taken unchanged from the archive. Mirror solution 16297 recorded as an alternative.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 122 ± 4 km, volume-equivalent diameter DAMIT lists for this size-calibrated model. DAMIT marks the model as size-calibrated and lists an equivalent diameter of 122 ± 4 km with it; the model references describe the scaling.

entries.subject: Hippo whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 22 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.951 at 462 nm, 1.002 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#393836 in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 4% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 0.9%), from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2012, ApJ 759, L8; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
